title: Your progress, in focus
body:
Countrydle 1.9.0 brings fuller player profiles, clearer game conversations, and a better view of your daily results.

YOUR PROFILE, ACROSS ALL NINE DAILY GAMES
- Explore statistics and completed-game history for Countrydle, Flagdle, the four continental challenges, US States, Polish Voivodeships, and Powiatdle.
- See your points, wins, win rate, streaks, and averages for each mode. Today's and future puzzle answers stay hidden in profile history.
- Finished friend duels have their own results section, separate from daily points and rankings.

A CLEARER VIEW OF THE LEADERBOARDS
- Choose any of the nine daily games, compare monthly standings or all-time average points, search for a player, and use Find Me to locate your own result.
- Rankings count actual play, not simply opening a puzzle. Average rankings use completed games and show the minimum-games requirement.
- Corrected streak calculations follow consecutive puzzle dates, so missed days break a daily streak correctly.

BETTER QUESTION CONVERSATIONS
- Questions and answers now read as a conversation in the question-based daily games.
- Submission warnings stay in the conversation and can be collapsed, so you can keep the explanation without losing track of play.
- Clearer feedback helps you distinguish a rejected move from a connection problem with an unconfirmed outcome. If receipt is uncertain, check your history before retrying.

REMEMBER ME, WHEN YOU WANT IT
- An optional Remember me checkbox is available for password and Google sign-in. It is off by default.
- On a trusted personal device, it keeps you signed in with a rolling 90-day inactivity window under the default settings. Signing out or clearing cookies ends that browser session.

SMALL DETAILS, BETTER CLARITY
- Friend-duel instructions now explain the existing rules more clearly: no overall question or guess cap, one action per turn, and timers still apply.
- X and WhatsApp sharing buttons now use recognizable platform logos.
- Updated About and FAQ pages explain the current modes, scoring, guest progress, archives, account options, and the limitations of AI-generated answers.

A HOME FOR WHAT'S NEW
- Open More > Patch notes to read published updates, with their version numbers and publication dates.
